tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde gshegs bdun gyi smon lam 'don tshul 'jug pa bde bar bkod pa bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ gang gis mtshan thos dran cing brjod pas kyang*/ /'di phyi'i mi mthun rgud pa'i phyogs rnams dang*/ /sdig sgrib nyes brgya'i mun pa kun sel ba/ /bde gshegs nyi ma mched bdun la phyag 'tshal/ /'dir sman bla'i mdo dang cho ga rgyas pa nas 'byung ba'i smon lam khyad par can rnams zur du bkol nas rang gzhan gyi don du 'jug pa bde zhing phan yon che bar ma zad/ sman bla'i mdo dang cho ga'i don gyi snying po nyams su blang bar 'gyur bas/ sa gzhi byin rlabs dang spyan drangs nas yan lag bdun pa rnams phyogs gcig dang*/ smon lam rnams kyang phyogs gcig tu 'don tshul ni/ rten yod na bkram/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ mchog gsum rgyal bar sras bcas byin rlabs dang*/ /tshogs gnyis mnga' thang chos dbyings bden stobs kyis/ / snod bcud mchod tshogs kun dang lhan cig tu/ /bde ldan zhing gi bkod pa ltar gyur cig /mdun gyi nam mkhar gzhal med khang chen dbus/ /rin chen seng khrir pad zla'i gdan la sogs/ /bde gshegs rnams dang byang sems chos skyong ba'i/ /bzhugs gnas phun tshogs mdzes par grub gyur cig /shar phyogs gaṅgā'i bye rnyed 'das gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas zhing nas bde gshegs mched bdun dang*/ /thub dbang byang sems nyan rang bka' sdod tshogs/ /'khor bcas brtse bas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang*/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ / zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi 'jug tu mkhan chen zhi 'tsho la sogs bla ma dang*/ /bde gshegs bdun dang thub dbang dam pa'i chos/ /'jal dpal skyabs grol gsang bdag tshangs dbang dang*/ /rgyal chen gnod sbyin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa zhes sogs kyis phyag byas nas/ ma ṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ra 'dod na phul la/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs sgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/

/mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan drug la'ang sbyar te/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa rnams lan bdun brjod/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ dam pa'i chos rnams dang*/ 'jal dpal dang skyabs grol dang phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum mam gcig de nas 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag la mchod yon dang zhes sogs ltar ram/ bsdu na/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la bdag pos bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs ji snyed mchis pa thams cad 'bul par bgyi'o/ /sdig ltung nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /rang gzhan skye 'phags kun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos gyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /de dag thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba kun kyang bdag gzhan ma lus pa bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /de nas deng rgyal sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa bdun dang*/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i mtshan nas brjod pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir te rims dang gshed byed dang byad dang ro langs dang 'jigs pa sna tshogs kyis gtses pa de dag thams cad kyi gnod pa dang nad thams cad 'phral du zhi bar gyur cigabyang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du rims dang sdig pa can gyi gdon dang nad thams cad med par gyur cig

/bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag long ba dang 'on pa dang smyon pa dang*/ sha bkra dang nad tshab chen pos btab par gyur pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbang po thams cad yongs su tshang bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang nad thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cigabadag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis bsgribs pa/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa/ bya ba ma yin pa'i spyod pa mang ba dam pa'i chos spong ba sdig pa mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs byed pa/ ngan song gsum dang sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba de dag sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes nas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang zhing zad par gyur cig /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i bar du yang sems can dmyal ba dang ngan 'gror 'gro bar ma gyur cigalha yul ba'i lha'i bde ba dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dbul bor gyur te zas dang skom dang gos dang nor dang 'bru dang mal cha dang spos dang 'phreng ba dang yo byad mi bdog pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbyig dang gos dang nor dang 'bru dang mal cha dang spos dang 'phreng ba dang yo byad 'phel bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bcing ba dang rdeg pa go rar gzhug pa dang mtshon cha'i tshogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir ba de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bcing ba dang rdeg pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lus kyi gdung ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mgon med par gyur pa lus la gdung ba'i me 'bar ba dang*/ seng ge dang stag dang dom dang dred dang sbrul gdug pa'i nang du chud de srog la bab cing nyam thag pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du lus la gdung ba'i me thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig

/seṅge dang stag dang dom dang dred dang sbrul gdug pa de dag kyang byams pa la gnas par gyur ciga'ajigs pa med pa dang zhi ba'i gnas la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag phan tshun 'thab pa dang rtsod cing 'gyed par gyur te 'khrugs shing 'jigs skrag nas dngangs pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dang 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cigaphan tshun byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag chu'i nang du son pa grur zhugs pa gling med par phyin pa srog 'dod pa chu klung dang rgya mtsho'i nang du son te smre sngags sna tshogs 'don pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du chu klung chen po de las dbugs 'byin pa sbyin par gyur cig 'jigs pa med par rgal bar gyur cig ces mtshan legs dang*/ 7 bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag zhing slas kyi las kyis mtha' dang tshong la dga' ste g.yeng ba sna tshogs mang bas dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs rnams dang byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las yongs su nyams te 'khor ba na 'khyams zhing so sor 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang rgud pa dang 'chi ba dang mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba dang 'khrug pa sna tshogs so sor myong ba de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du bza' ba dang bgo ba dang btung ba dang longs spyod dang yongs su spyad pa dang nor dang 'bru dang dbyig dang gser rnams 'byung zhing 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /dge ba'i chos rnams kyis rnam pa 'phel bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /ngan song dang sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag grang ba dang tsha ba dang bkres pa dang skom pas lus yongs su gdung shing sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyams thag pa de dag thams cad sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa de dag thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig

skye ba de yang mtha' mar gyur cigabla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du skye ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cigabud med gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir zhing bud med kyi skye gnas la smod pa dang sems can gang dag btsal ba'i dus kyi sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /skye ba de yang mtha' mar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du skyes pa nyid thob par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'chi ba dang dgra dang dgon pa'i gnod pas gtses pa dang phan tshun pha ma dang sring mo dang mdza' bshes dang nye du'i mya ngan myong zhing sdug bsngal ba dang mya ngan gyi zug rngus lus la zug pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du 'chi ba dang dgra dang dgon pa'i gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /mya ngan dang sdug bsngal thams cad bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mtshan mo mun pa mun nag na rnam par rgyu ba las kyi mtha' rnam pa sna tshogs la zhugs pa sdig pa can gyi gdon sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ 'jigs pa dang smre sngags sna tshogs 'don pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du mun pa mun nag thams cad med par gyur cigasdig pa can gyi gdon thams cad las thar bar gyur cig mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba sna tshogs la mngon par brtson par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dman pa la mos shing shes rab chung ba dran pa rmongs te dge ba'i chos rnams dang stobs dang byang chub kyi yan lag dang ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun rjes su dran pa las yongs su nyams pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du ting nge 'dzin dang dran pa dang stobs dang gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mngon du gyur cig

/shes rab chen po rjes su rgyu bar gyur cigabadag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dman pa la mos shing nyan thos kyi theg pa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la 'dod pa bskyed de/ de la gnas shing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rgyab kyis phyogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bla na med pa yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las yang dag par 'das par gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bskal ba chen po zad pa'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling kun tu 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'khrugs par gyur te ngu zhing mya ngan byed la sngon mi dge ba'i las kyi rgyus sdug bsngal 'byung zhing skyabs med mgon med pa de dag thams cad sdug bsngal dang mya ngan dang bral bar gyur cig /bsil ba'i dngos po thob par gyur cigaces sgra dbyangs dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag srog gcod pa mi dge ba'i las rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa srog chags sna tshogs kyi srog gcod pa'i las byas pas tshe thung zhing nad mang ba dang chu dang dug dang mtshon dang me dang nad sna tshogs kyis 'chi bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad las kyi sgrib pa de dag thams cad yongs su byang ste tshe ring bar gyur cigand med par gyur cig /su yang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par ma gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sdig pa mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs byas te/ gzhan gyi rdzas brkus phrogs pas dbul bor skyes te sgren mo dang bkres pa dang skom pas lus yongs su gdung shing sdug bsngal myong ba de dag thams cad 'phral du sdig pa thams cad byang ste byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbang phyug phun sum tshogs shing ma tshang ba med pa thob par gyur cig

/bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gcig la gcig gnod sems dang ldan zhing phan tshun srog gcod par byed pa dang 'thab bar byed pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du phan tshun pha ma ltar byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis bsgribs te tshul khrims 'chal bar gyur nas sdig pa kun tu spyod cing bslab pa bral la dad pas byin pa longs spyod pas ngan song gsum du ltung zhing dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad 'phral du las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi snying bo la thug gi bar du tshul khrims yang dag par 'dzin zhing lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdom pa la gnas par gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /tad+ya thā/ sid+dhe sid+dhe su sid+dhe mo tsa ni/ mok+ṣa ni muk+te bi muk+te/ a ma le bi ma le maṃ ga l+ye/ hi ran+ya gar+bhe rat+na gar+bhe/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ ba ra mār+tha sā dha ni/ ma na si/ ma hā ma na si/ ad+bhū te/ a t+yad+bhū te/ bhī ta bha ye su bar+ṇe prah+ma gho ṣe/ prah+mā dh+yu ṣi te/ sar+b+ba ar+the ṣu a pa rā dzi te/ sarba tra a pra ti ha te/ tsa tuḥṣa ṣ+ṭhi pud+dha kau ṭi bhā ṣi te/ na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga tā nāṃ swāhā/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang dri med rin cen snang brtul zhugs grub pa des byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs te sems can 'dod chags zhe sdang dang gti mug gis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba 'chi ba dang dgra dang dgon pas gnod par gyur pa/ tshe bskal bar thub pa'i sems can dmyal bar gzhol ba'i sems can rnams gzigs nas de dag gi don du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la dgod pa dang las kyi sgrib pa thams cad zad par bya ba'i phyir gzungs sngags kyi gzhi gsungs pa 'di bzlas pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa sdig pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig

/re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur ciga'achi ba'i tshe yang bcom ldan 'das gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pas dgongs pa gyur cig /ces gser bzang dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag mya ngan dang sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba dang 'khrugs pa mang ba dang sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs myong ba de dag thams cad kyi mya ngan dang sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba dang 'khrugs pa mang ba de dag rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /su yang sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar ma gyur cig tshe ring bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sdig pa mi dge ba sna tshogs byas te mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen po mun pa mun nag chen po can du skye bar 'gyur ba'am skyes pa de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal gyi sku las 'od zer gyi snang ba byung bas reg cing mthong bar gyur te de ma thag tu sdig pa thams cad byang nas sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de dag thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cigabyang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cigabadag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sngon sdig pa mi dge ba bgyis te gzhan gyi rdzas phrogs pas dbul po dman pa'i khyim du skyes nas gos dang bza' ba dang btung ba dang mal cha dang rgyan mi bdog pa/ grang ba dang tsha ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba dang bkres pa skom pas lus gzir zhing mdog ngan par gyur pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bgo ba dang bza' ba dang btung ba dang mal cha thams cad la longs spyod par gyur cig /lus la lha'i lus kyi kha dog gis brgyan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 'byung po dang sha za rnams kyis gtses shing mdangs phrogs te nad kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 'byung po dang sha za rnams kyis gtses shing mdangs 'phrog pa thams cad rab tu zhi zhing byams pa la gnas par gyur cig

/nad kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs las yongs su thar bar gyur cigaces mya ngan med mchog dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag log par lta ba can gyi khyim du skyes pas sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la ma dad pa byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las ring du 'gyur ba de dag las kyi sgrib pa de zad par gyur nas byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du yang dag pa'i lta ba can du gyur cig /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la dad pa mi phyed pa dang ldan par gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gang na sangs rgyas kyi sgra mi grags pa/ chos kyi sgra mi grags pa/ dge 'dun gyi sgra mi grags pa yul mtha' 'khob tu skyes te mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyus sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag de nas shi 'phos nas ngan song gsum du ltung zhing dge ba'i chos rnams las nyams par 'gyur ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa chos sgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi mtshan rna lam du grag par gyur te chos kyi sprin dang rgya mtsho'i sgra 'byung bar gyur cig /de dag gi chos kyi sgra de thos nas sngon gyi las zad par gyur te byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gos dang rgyan dang spos dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang mal cha dang na ba'i gsos sman dang bral zhing mi ldan pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal myong zhing sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag gos dang rgyan dang spos dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang mal cha dang na ba'i gsos sman dang longs spyod rnams bsams ma thag tu 'byung zhing mi ldan pa med par gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du su yang ci dang yang mi ldan pa med par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas phan tshun 'thab mo 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dang 'gyed par gyur te gcig la gcig gnod par bya ba dang gsad par bya ba'i phyir rtul ba mtshon dang mda' dang dbyig pa dag gis bsnun te sdug bsngal bar gyur pa de dag mda' dang mtshon dang dbyig pa la sogs pa las slar log par gyur cigaphyir phyogs par gyur cig

/dgra thams cad kyang byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /su'i srog gi dbang po yang 'gag par ma gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du rang rang gi rdzas dang longs spyod dang dbang phyug dag gis chog shes par gyur cig /ces chos sgrags rgya mtsho dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag zhing las dang sa bon 'debs pa dang tshong byed pa dang 'thab mo dang rtsod pa la sogs pa sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag thams cad bsams ma thag tu 'tshog chas thams cad 'byor bar gyur cig /gnod sems med par gyur cig /rtag tu dge ba'i chos byed par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par blangs pas sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can gang yang dmyal bar 'gro bar ma gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gzhan gyi dbang du song ste chad pas bcad pa dang bcing ba dang rdeg pa dang go rar gzhug pa dang gsad pa'i 'os su gyur pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bcings pa dang rdeg pa la sogs pa las thar bar gyur cig /bla na med pa'i rang dbang phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag tshe thung bar gyur pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba sna tshogs byas te 'chi bar gyur pa de dag thams cad sdig pa'i las thams cad yongs su byang ste tshe ring zhing dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur bas nam yang 'ga' yang 'chi bar ma gyur cig /'chi khar yang de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol bas mngon par mkhyen pa'i mtshan rna lam du grags cing rjes su dran nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /ces chos rgya mtsho dang*/ bdag bcag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus legs par brgyan par gyur te bdag ci 'dra ba de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang de 'dra bar gyur cig

/lus kyi 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa dpag gis mi lang ba dag lham me lhan ne lhang nger gyur cig /lus nor bu rin po che bai ḍūr+ya ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar phyi nang shin tu yongs su dag pa dang dri ma med la 'od gsal ba dang kho lags yangs shing rgya che ba dang dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang legs par gnas pa dang nyi ma dang zla ba bas lhag pa'i 'od zer gyi dra ba rnams kyis legs par brgyan par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar gyur te sems can gang dag 'jig rten gyi bar dag tu skyes pa dag dang gang dag yang mi'i 'jig rten 'di na mtshan mo mun pa mun nag gi nang na phyogs tha dad par 'gro ba de dag thams cad bdag gi 'od kyis phyogs dga' mgur 'gro zhing las rnams kyang byed par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i shes rab dang thabs dpag tu med pas bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gyi khams dpag gis mi lang ba dag longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang ldan par gyur te su yang cis kyang brel ba med par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag lam ngan par zhugs pa dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam du zhugs pa de dag thams cad theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i lam la zhugs pa gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du sdom pa gsum gyis bsdams pa dang tshul khrims nyams pa med par gyur cig /su yang tshul khrims log par zhugs te ngan 'gror 'gro bar ma gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag lus ngan pa dang dbang po ma tshang ba dang mdog mi sdug pa dang bem po dang yan lag skyon can dang rgur po dang sha bkra can dang zhar ba dang long ba dang 'on pa dang smyon pa dang lus la nad kyis btab pa de dag thams cad kyi las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang nas thams cad dbang po tshang zhing yan lag yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig

/bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba skyabs med pa mgon med pa 'tshog chas dang sman mi bdog pa/ dpung gnyen med pa/ dbul ba sdug bsngal ba de dag gi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du nad med cing gnod pa med pa dang yo byad phun sum tshogs pa la gnas par gyur cig /bud med gang dag bud med kyi skyon brgya dag gis kun nas nyon mongs pa gyur pa bud med kyi dngos po la mi dga' ba/ bud med kyi skye gnas las thar bar 'dod pa de dag thams cad bud med kyi dngos po las log par gyur cig byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du skyes pa'i dbang po dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad bdud kyi zhags pa las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lta ba tha dad pa mi mthun pa zang zing pas mi mthun pa dag spangs te yang dag pa'i lta ba la gnas par gyur cig /byang chub kyi spyod pa brlabs po che yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang su dag rgyal po'i 'jigs pas skrag pa dang*/ gang dag bcing ba dang rdeg pa dang go rar gzhug pa dang gsad par 'os pa rgyu du mas kun tu gtses pa/ nga rgyal dang bral ba lus dang ngag dang sems sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa de dag bdag gi bsod nams kyi mthus gnod pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cigabadag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bkres pa dang skom pa'i me rab tu 'bar ba/ kha zas 'tshol ba la rab tu brtson pa sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag bdag gis kha dog dang dri dang ror ldan pa'i bza' btung gis tshim par byas te phyis chos kyi ros shin tu bde ba la 'god par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sgren mo bgo ba med pa dbul ba sdug bsngal ba grang ba dang tsha ba dang sbrang bu dang sha sbrang dag gis nyin mtshan du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag bdag gis gos yongs su spyad par 'os pa/

tshon sna tshogs su kha bsgyur pa dag dang rin po che'i rgyan dang spud pa dang 'phreng ba dang byug ba dang rol mo'i sgra dang sil snyan dang*/ pheg rdob pa rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims kyi dga' ba dang ldan par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa'i gdung bas mi brdzi bar rnam par grol ba'i bde ba la gnas par gyur cig /ces sman bla'i smon lam rnams brjod nas/ mthar thun mong du/ bcom ldan bde bar gshegs pa mched bdun gyis/ /sngon tshe smon lam khyad 'phags mang btab 'bras/ /dpag med mkhyen rtse nus mthu'i byin brlabs kyis/ /deng 'dir bdag sogs 'gro bas longs spyod shog /thub pa'i bstan dar skye rgu bde zhing sky-id/ /khyad par bdag cag rnams kyi gtso byas pa'i/ /'gro rnams sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis po/ /rab rdzogs byang chen myur du thob byin rlobs/ /sbyin bdag gi don yin na/ khyad par sbyin pa'i bdag pos zhes sam/ tshe 'das sam/ dmigs yul 'di yis zhes sbyar bas brjod/ de nas spro na/ ghu me ghu me sogs gzungs ring thung ci 'grub bzlas nas 'jug bsdu bar bya'o/ /yang na thal mo sbyar te/ bde bar gshegs pa mched bdun gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaces lan bdun sogs brjod pas thams cad kyi sku'i cha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs de nas rang gi snying gar zhugs nas byin gyis rlobs bar bsam/ tshul 'di ni tshogs zhing lta bu yin gyis/ cho ga dngos min pas brtan bzhugs dang gshegs gsol sogs btang snyoms las ma byas kyang rung la/ 'dod na/ ma rnyed zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /zhes sogs gshegs gsol dang*/

smon lam dang shis brjod kyang bya'o/ /'di ni ras bris sam pho brang yod pa la bltos pa'i lugs yin kyang*/ pho brang bkram nas mchod cing smon par 'dod na'ang rung zhing mdo chog gi snying po bsdus pa'i nyams len du 'gyur pas sman bla rgyas pa ma lcogs pa dag gam/ gzhan gyis kyang rgyun pa'i zhal 'don byed pa la 'jug pa bde zhing legs pa yin no/ /cher snyigs 'gro la rjes brtse 'gro ba'i mgon/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa mched bdun gyis/ /sngon tshe smom lam ji ltar mdzad pa'i don/ /deng 'dir bdag sogs rnams la 'grub gyur cig/ces pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan dag la phan 'dod kyi 'dun pas co ne'i dgon nyin du bsgrigs so// ༈ //oṃ sā sti/ gang gis mtshan brjod smos pa'i nyi 'od kyis/ /sdig ltung nyes pa'i mun stugs kun bcom nas/ /mngon mtho nges legs phan bde'i snang ba mchog/ster mdzad bde gshegs bdun la slar phyag 'tshal/ /ston pa nyid kyis mdo sde brgyad brgya bar/ /bde gshegs mched bdun sngon gyi smon lam kun/ /ji skad bshad de don gyi snying po rnams/ /tshang ba'i smon lam khyad 'phags 'di na mchis/ /gang gis dal 'byor rten 'dir rang rgyud la/ /bag chags bzang po 'jog phyir mtshan nyid kyi/ /bshad grwar mtshan gdags mdzad dus rang gzhan la/ /phan phyir smon lam 'di nyid par du bskrun/ /de ltar bsgrub pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan kun/ /gnas skabs mi mthun rgud pa'i phyogs zhi zhing*/ /phyi ma lha mi'i rten rnyed dag zhing du/ /skyes nas bla med byang chub myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni the bo stod kyi dpon chung gi tsha bo blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis grwa tshang du rab 'byams smra ba'i mtshan gdags mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'di rang gzhan la phan thogs par bsams nas par du brko ba'i skabs su par byang dgos ces bskul ba ltar bris so//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bde gshegs bdun gyi smon lam 'don tshul 'jug pa bde ba bkod pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 18--PAGE 17--PAGE 1-
